actual_visual_inspection.observed: All 50 IDs appear in each browser collar atlas with the expected context/state columns. At the stored crop scale, no blank supported shirt/tie panel or obvious accidental shirt-ID substitution was found. The tied cells visibly contain a tie and No Tie cells have no tie. This does not certify seamless collars or physical-photo fidelity.
actual_visual_inspection.UI_observed: Picker photographs, same-ID labels and Cancel/Apply controls are visible in both mobile browser screenshots. The B01 screenshot shows the explicit summer-weekend-dinner control with No Tie. Native select backgrounds differ between Chromium and WebKit. Screenshots show only the captured viewport; successful all-row binding assertions are recorded separately.

documented_visual_differences.observed: Suit retains the larger-check insert; non-suit shows the smaller pink/light-blue/white gingham photographed source.
documented_visual_differences.interpretation: New non-suit reconstruction alone uses the newer small gingham. Original suit artwork was deliberately preserved.

documented_visual_differences.observed: Suit has a more muted slate-blue appearance; non-suit is dark navy.
authority: V6 PDF page 40: newer owner-supplied authoritative photograph; historical slate/denim caption superseded
documented_visual_differences.interpretation: Batch5 uses its own PDF photograph for new full-length cloth; same-ID collar alpha is preserved and RGB gain is recorded. Existing suit source remains. This is not proof that the older suit appearance matches the newer physical source photograph.

documented_visual_differences.observed: Suit GG cloth is warmer and has different visible repeat/lighting from the non-suit source-derived garment. No Tie only.
documented_visual_differences.interpretation: Recipe explicitly retains original suit insert while reconstructing non-suit front/sleeves from the supplied partial/back photograph. Front fit is inferred. Approval-mapping path is traced metadata, not an independently inspected file.

documented_visual_differences.observed: Suit and non-suit plaid orientations/appearance differ; non-suit has a diagonal repeat. No Tie only.
documented_visual_differences.interpretation: Recipe records same-photo rectified diagonal cloth, 180-degree orientation and a 160px repeat for inferred front/sleeves, while preserving original suit insert. The V6 operative text supersedes a historical caption; exact source photo and recorded mapping govern this review.

documented_visual_differences.observed: Operative same-ID native pattern differs from the PDF pattern representation.
documented_visual_differences.interpretation: Recipes retain distinct same-ID registered cloth and use the own-PDF image for low-frequency folds only. No merged IDs or substituted neighboring shirt cloth were inferred.

documented_visual_differences.observed: No Tie presentation remains buttoned at the top.
documented_visual_differences.interpretation: No Tie describes accessory absence, not an open top button. Preserved source is DS027_CLOSED_OWNER_ORIGINAL.jpeg.

documented_visual_differences.observed: Isolated suit thumbnails are masked inserts, whereas reviewed composed native crop has filled chest under the collar/tie.
authority: stored native-collars-07.png in both browser artifacts
documented_visual_differences.interpretation: No missing chest was observed in the supported composed crop. All 28 wider-suit native frames have baseline-equal hashes; these 28 were not separately displayed as full-size images in this review.
